runner.reason: The runner cannot build or execute the Windows Unity Player, inspect Win32 window styles, invoke Windows TTS, or collect licensed external VRM smoke evidence.

criteria.title: Separate transparent Companion window
felixEvidence: Screenshot main UI and separate transparent Companion window on the selected monitor and scale.
Attach parent-first.log and processes-first.json.

criteria.title: Exactly one isolated display child and connected IPC
felixEvidence: result.json reports one child for each parent launch and both IPC connections.
Task Manager or Process Explorer screenshot shows the two Player processes.

criteria.title: Child initializes no provider, secret, session, chat, plugin, or voice services
felixEvidence: Child log contains display-only startup and no parent bootstrap/provider/session initialization.
Protected provider/session/secret hashes in result.json are unchanged.

criteria.title: Static, sprite, generic GLB/glTF, VRM 0.x, and VRM 1.0 display compatibility
felixEvidence: Run the explicit VRM test with NEON_PHASE_D_VRM0_FIXTURE set to a licensed VRM 0.x model.
Record gallery and Companion screenshots for legacy static/sprite, synthetic GLB/glTF, Neon VRM 1.0, and the external VRM 0.x fixture.

criteria.title: Idle, listening, thinking, speaking, reaction, and stop state parity
felixEvidence: Record a short screen capture showing state changes in the main preview and Companion window.
Confirm unavailable optional VRM features remain disabled without breaking idle rendering.

criteria.title: TTS lipsync and immediate stop, cancel, interrupt, and barge-in reset
felixEvidence: Record TTS mouth movement in both windows, then stop and begin recording mid-playback.
Confirm mouth, speaking state, busy indicator, and queued speech clear immediately and a later TTS can play.

criteria.title: Visible, pin, click-through, monitor, scale, and position persist across restart
felixEvidence: Set non-default controls before the harness; attach appsettings-before.json, appsettings-after.json, and result.json.
Screenshot the restored window after the second launch.

criteria.title: Drag, Settings, Column, Show/Hide, Pin, click-through, and emergency release controls
felixEvidence: Record manual control smoke including drag and navigation buttons.
Enable click-through and prove Ctrl+Shift+F12 restores interaction.

criteria.title: Child close or crash does not terminate or corrupt the parent chat
felixEvidence: Harness force-closes the first child and proves the parent remains alive.
Manually send a message afterward and confirm the same session and history remain usable.

criteria.title: Parent shutdown removes the child; non-Windows builds never spawn it
felixEvidence: result.json proves the second child exits after its parent closes.
Android and iOS smoke records no child process and no Windows-only Companion card.
